# DigiScale Infotech — Complete Knowledge Documentation

## Overview
DigiScale Infotech (founded 2023) is a technology development agency headquartered in Surat, Gujarat, India. The company specializes in modern web development, custom software engineering, Shopify store creation, AI automation, and mobile application development.

## Service Offerings

### 1. Web Development & Web Applications
- Stack: React, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Render, Vercel, AWS.
- Features: Server-side rendering, static site generation, single page applications (SPAs), responsive dark/light UI, fast LCP & CLS optimization, WCAG accessibility compliance, security hardening.

### 2. Shopify & E-Commerce Solutions
- Capabilities: Theme customization, custom Liquid / React components, headless storefronts (Shopify Storefront API), payment gateway integrations (Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, UPI), inventory sync, private app development.

### 3. AI Automation & Intelligent Workflows
- Solutions: LLM API integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini), custom AI agents, automated email & CRM pipelines, automated data scraping & enrichment, customer support chatbots.

### 4. Mobile Application Development
- Stack: React Native, Expo, Flutter, iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin).
- Capabilities: Native device integrations, push notifications, offline storage, secure authentication.

### 5. UI/UX Design & Brand System
- Services: Figma design systems, wireframing, high-fidelity prototypes, user research, interaction design.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Where is DigiScale Infotech located?
A: DigiScale Infotech is located in Surat, Gujarat, India (Zip Code: 395007). We serve clients locally in Surat, across Gujarat, India, as well as global B2B clients in the USA, UK, UAE, Australia, and Europe.

### Q: How can clients contact DigiScale Infotech?
A: You can reach us via email at hello@digiscaleinfotech.com or via WhatsApp / Phone at +91 98982 13183. You can also submit inquiries at https://digiscaleinfotech.com/contact.

### Q: Does DigiScale Infotech build custom software for startups?
A: Yes, DigiScale Infotech specializes in building Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and scaling production applications for startups and growing enterprises.
